LuckyBlox Launcher 0.7 Changelog Includes versions from 0.4 or newer ///
Release 0.7
-Removed obfuscator protection and now open sourced! -Added Memberships! (Only for 2020M-2021M clients, experimental function) -The ability to select custom maps has been replaced with the ability to add custom maps to the list -Now, when you join a server, its name will be the name of the selected map from the list (very buggy, working only in solo)
Release 0.6
-Added 2021M Client -Added REAL 2020L Client but without player (renamed older 2020L to 2020M) -I am forget to notice in the 0.6_1 snapshot in 2008M are deleted RCC (uses client to host game sessions) -Some fixes and other
Snapshot 0.6_1: (Private Release/Early access)
-Added setting to Enable or Disable Adonis admin -Added button to launch 2022M Studio without map -Better listboxs and text labels -Added few old maps optimized for 2008M client -Added Asset Packs (LAP Asset Pack) -Added Asset Importer -Added DiscordRPC and option to change RPC info (Enable/Disable and Self)
Release 0.5.1:
-Fixed mistake in a window name ("LuckyBlox Launcher 0.4" > "LuckyBlox Launcher [CURRENT VERSION]") -Fixed few mistakes with assetloader in 2019M Client -Added helpful window's -Added more phrases in the upper text
Release 0.5:
-Big launcher interface 1366x768 -Added 2019M Client -Now any client has information (added description and build of version text in Clients) -Fixed few information in changelog -Added more phrases in the upper text
Release 0.4:
-Added Settings -Now the choised map can be in .RBXLX (XML Roblox Place) file format. -Now on English only -Can be installed with unofficial installer (based on inno setup, TODO work this you need to check the "unins000.exe" are in the folder with LuckyBlox Launcher.exe) -Any custom Body Color on body, deleted the player dool -Added fun text upper with random phrase and LuckyBlox Launcher logo -Changed theme to Dark and changed logo -More functional with choising map in the Host
If you looking for older versions changelog try install older version of LuckyBlox Launcher
